description: Build a lightweight HTTP server (using msw, nock, or a custom express app) that simulates the GitHub API endpoints Otto uses: GET /user, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/comments, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}, POST and PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments, GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments (thread fetch). Supports seeding fixture comments and recording which API calls were made.
title: Fake GitHub API server for integration tests
